YouTube with Shorts and comments removed, plus clean removal of like/dislike buttons and video view counts.

Keeps titles, channel links, dates, descriptions, and the remaining video controls. Based on YouTube 21.20.4.

Install over the existing app to preserve its data and sign-in.
